about:
Southern Medical Corporation was founded in 1987 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, in response to a shortage of trained technologists able to perform competent cardiovascular services. The company began as a provider of specialized technical staffing and services for the cardiovascular field.

Today, SMC delivers a range of technical, ultrasound, and nuclear services, along with biomedical resources and management consulting. The firm operates mobile ultrasound units across Louisiana, Mississippi, and Texas, serving healthcare facilities with on-site imaging and diagnostic support.

Its customer base includes hospitals, clinics, and medical practices seeking cardiovascular and diagnostic services. Affiliates such as American Diagnostic Technologies and Etech Medical Solution extend its reach into equipment supply and specialized medical solutions.

The company emphasizes a comprehensive service portfolio and a reputation for quality and dependability, aiming to fill the gap in qualified cardiovascular technologists that prompted its founding.
